text: dsh-ui-reload 为 DSH Web 客户端添加会话页眉刷新按钮，位置在分享按钮左侧。点击后按钮显示短暂忙碌状态，并在约 400 毫秒后重新加载整个页面，以载入更新后的前端和客户端插件资源。它适合在插件列表、样式或页面外壳变化后需要完整刷新时使用；主机保存的对话、工作区和连接状态可保留。客户端组件通过 slots 注册，主机入口为空操作以满足 bundle 挂载。代码未读取 API key 或请求外部业务服务。

dsh-ui-reload adds a refresh button beside Share in the DSH conversation header. Clicking it shows brief feedback, then reloads the full page after about 400 ms to pick up frontend changes. The client registers through slots; its host entry is a no-op for bundle mounting.
我想在 DSH 对话页里加一个按钮，点一下就完整刷新前端。
插件列表或界面样式更新后，怎么让正在打开的 DSH 页面重新载入？
How can I add a one-click full-page refresh control to the DSH conversation header?
dsh-ui-reload 的功能「完整刷新前端」：在会话页眉工具区显示刷新按钮。用户点击后看到短暂忙碌反馈，约 400 毫秒后浏览器重新加载整个页面。

dsh-ui-reload README · dsh-ui-reload：A "reload the whole frontend" button in the DSH conversation session header, immediately left of the share button.

Clicking it reloads the entire page — the one operation that reliably picks up anything the frontend can be out of sync with: client plugin bundles rebuilt under the running page, plugin-list changes, stale CSS, and the shell's own code.

dsh-ui-reload README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Mode | Web UI (`web` or `desktop` profile) — there is no CLI surface |

Earlier DSH releases are untested. The button mounts into the slot `conversation.session.header.utilities`; a release that renames or removes that slot leaves it unrendered.

dsh-ui-reload README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row is appended to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start. Reload the page once after installing — the client half is served as a separate module.

Manual install:

```yaml

dsh-ui-reload README · ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: ui-reload
      name: 'dsh-ui-reload'
```

dsh-ui-reload README · Why a full reload and not HMR：DSH already ships `dsh-client-hmr`, which republishes a plugin the moment its bundle changes. This button exists for the residue that path cannot reach — a page whose shell or bootstrap predates a change, or state that only a real document load clears. Reloading the document is the only thing that covers all of it.

**What survives a click:** conversation, workspace and connection state — they live on the host.
section: Why a full reload and not HMR

text: dsh-ui-reload README · Why a full reload and not HMR：**What does not:** anything held only in the page — scroll position, open panels, in-flight composer text, running client-side timers.
section: Why a full reload and not HMR

text:
dsh-ui-reload README · How it works：- `lib/index.js` — the host half. It exports an empty `apply()` and registers no route, service or watcher, because a plain page reload needs nothing from the host. It exists only so the bundle row has something to mount; dropping it would stop the package from being composed at all, taking the client button with it.
- `lib/client.js` — the browser half, injected through `dsh.client.inject: ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots"]`. It registers the button into `conversation.session.header.utilities` and calls `window.location.reload()` on click, after a 400 ms acknowledgement so the click registers visually before the load takes over.
